conditions.instructions: Gentle hair care; balanced protein/iron; avoid harsh chemicals/heat; track shedding.
conditions.red_flags: Sudden patchy loss, scalp infection, thyroid signs → clinician.
conditions.followup: Review in 4-6 weeks; track shedding count.

conditions.instructions: Balanced diet, portion control, daily walk 30 min, sleep 7-8h; track waist.
conditions.red_flags: Chest pain, breathlessness, uncontrolled BP/sugar → urgent care.
conditions.followup: Review weight/waist in 4 weeks.

conditions.instructions: Sleep hygiene, screen breaks, breathing exercises; note triggers.
conditions.red_flags: Harm to self/others, uncontrollable rage → urgent help.
conditions.followup: Review mood/sleep in 2 weeks.

conditions.instructions: Fixed sleep time, single-tasking, short breaks; limit caffeine late.
conditions.red_flags: Suicidal thoughts, inability to function → urgent help.
conditions.followup: Review focus/sleep in 2-3 weeks.

conditions.instructions: Hydration, regular meals, gentle activity; check sleep.
conditions.red_flags: Fainting, chest pain, severe pallor → clinician.
conditions.followup: Review energy in 2 weeks.

conditions.instructions: Warm fluids, honey (adults), avoid smoke/dust; note dry/wet, night worse.
conditions.red_flags: Breathlessness, chest pain, blood, high fever → urgent.
conditions.followup: Review in 48-72h if acute.

conditions.instructions: Saline rinse, fluids, rest; note discharge color, allergy triggers.
conditions.red_flags: Breathing difficulty, high fever >3 days → clinician.
conditions.followup: Review in 3-5 days.

conditions.instructions: Fluids, rest, light clothing; record temperature pattern.
conditions.red_flags: Temp >103F, stiff neck, rash, dehydration → urgent.
conditions.followup: Review in 24-48h.

conditions.instructions: Rest in quiet room, fluids; note side, time, triggers.
conditions.red_flags: Sudden severe, vision change, weakness → urgent.
conditions.followup: Review pattern in 1-2 weeks.

conditions.instructions: Small frequent meals, chew well, avoid late-night heavy food.
conditions.red_flags: Blood in stool/vomit, severe pain, dehydration → urgent.
conditions.followup: Review digestion in 1-2 weeks.

conditions.instructions: General supportive care; balanced diet, fluids, rest, hygiene; note triggers and timing.
conditions.red_flags: Red flags (severe pain, bleeding, breathlessness, high fever, confusion) → urgent care.
conditions.followup: Review in 1-2 weeks; re-take case if unchanged.
